description: Reconstructs a working week from calendar, mail, chat, and GitHub activity; renders HTML and XLSX.

src/timesheet/reconstruct.py.role: Pure reconstruction core: calendar anchors → correspondence sittings → day-length estimate → free-time fill. No I/O.

src/timesheet/activity.py.role: Normalised activity events → git-hours estimate, correspondence sessions, block candidates.

src/timesheet/model.py.role: Data model: Day, Block, Week, and their serialisation.

src/timesheet/config.py.role: Config dataclass (frozen), all knobs with defaults. RECONSTRUCT_VERSION cache gate. from_env() and with_settings() entry points.

src/timesheet/periods.py.role: Named period helpers (this-week, last-week, etc.), date parsing, Mon-Sun week iteration.

src/timesheet/timeutil.py.role: Time arithmetic: hm(), snap to grid, overlap clipping.

src/timesheet/i18n.py.role: Locale strings (en/nl), cross-locale markers, Labels accessor with user overrides.

src/timesheet/summarize.py.role: Rule-based label summariser (deterministic fallback when LLM is off).

src/timesheet/llm.py.role: Optional OpenAI-compatible label polish. Only called from background refresh, never web requests.

src/timesheet/pipeline.py.role: collect() — live data pulls for one user's week. build_week() — pure reconstruction (testable offline). WeekBuild result carries days + per-source errors.

src/timesheet/collectors/normalize.py.role: Raw connector output → normalised ActivityEvent list.

src/timesheet/collectors/github.py.role: GitHub connector: commits, PRs opened, issues authored, PR reviews. Handles github.com, GHE Cloud (.ghe.com), and GHES (/api/v3).

src/timesheet/collectors/m365_graph.py.role: Microsoft Graph connector: calendar events, sent mail, received mail, Teams chat. Delegated token, read-only.

src/timesheet/collectors/m365_mcp.py.role: Microsoft connector via MCP (alternative to direct Graph calls).

src/timesheet/collectors/m365_ics.py.role: Calendar-only fallback: fetches a published .ics URL, expands recurring events. Meetings only, no mail/chat.

src/timesheet/collectors/mcp_client.py.role: MCP session client: device-code flow, token refresh, tool calls. McpAuthError / McpError for failure isolation.

src/timesheet/render/theme.py.role: Shared colour/style constants for HTML and XLSX renderers.

src/timesheet/service/auth.py.role: GitHub OAuth (github.com + GHE). Signed stateless state param, session cookie, ACCESS_POLICY enforcement.

src/timesheet/service/store.py.role: Persistence: PgStore (PostgreSQL) and FileStore (local dev). make_store() picks by DATABASE_URL. Every read takes a user_id — no cross-account queries possible.

src/timesheet/service/users.py.role: User record, settings CRUD, account deletion.

src/timesheet/service/delivery.py.role: Delivery orchestration: email and Teams chat channels. DELIVERY_CHAT_ENABLED is off by default.

src/timesheet/service/email.py.role: Email transport: SMTP and Mailgun HTTP API. Both build the same MIME message. Check (test-mode Mailgun / SMTP probe) and send-to-me paths.

src/timesheet/service/crypto.py.role: AES-256-GCM encryption/decryption of stored tokens. Refuses to operate without SECRET_KEY.

src/timesheet/service/web.py.role: HTML page rendering helpers, template context, response builders.

src/timesheet/run.py.role: CLI entry point: reconstruct all/one account, optional --send, --list, --user.

src/timesheet/demo.py.role: Offline demo: load a fixture JSON, reconstruct, write HTML + XLSX to a directory.

notable.test_auth.py: OAuth flow, state signing, access policy

key_env_vars.SECRET_KEY: AES-GCM key for stored tokens; service refuses to start without it
key_env_vars.PUBLIC_URL: Base URL; controls Secure cookie flag and OAuth callback
key_env_vars.GITHUB_HOST: Override for GHE Cloud or GHES (default: github.com)
key_env_vars.DATABASE_URL: PostgreSQL DSN; FileStore used when absent
key_env_vars.MAILGUN_BASE_URL: Mailgun API base URL (default: api.mailgun.net; eu: api.eu.mailgun.net)
key_env_vars.LIVE_MAX_AGE_SECONDS: How long a stored week is considered fresh (default 900)
